name: ballerinax/oracledb
description: This module provides the functionality required to access and manipulate data stored in an Oracle database. It enables seamless integration with OracleDB, supporting various data types and advanced database features.

typeDefs.name: SecureSocket
typeDefs.description: SSL configurations to be used when connecting to the Oracle database server.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Keystore configuration of the client certificates

fields.name: cert
fields.description: Truststore configuration of the trust certificates

typeDefs.name: Options
typeDefs.description: Provides an additional set of configurations related to the Oracle database connection.

fields.name: loginTimeout
fields.description: Timeout (in seconds) to be used when connecting to the Oracle server and authentication (0 means no timeout)

fields.name: autoCommit
fields.description: If true, commits automatically when the statement is complete

fields.name: connectTimeout
fields.description: Timeout (in seconds) to be used when connecting to the Oracle server

fields.name: socketTimeout
fields.description:
Socket timeout (in seconds) to be used during the read/write operations with the Oracle database server
(0 means no socket timeout)

fields.name: useXADatasource
fields.description: If true, uses XADatasource for transactions

typeDefs.name: IntervalYearToMonth
typeDefs.description: Represents a period of time in years and months.

typeDefs.name: IntervalDayToSecond
typeDefs.description: Represents a period of time in days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

typeDefs.name: ObjectType
typeDefs.description: Represents the Oracle UDT type, which is an abstraction of the real-world entities such as purchase orders that application programs deal with.

typeDefs.name: Varray
typeDefs.description: Represents an ordered set of data elements with a variable size but with a maximum size defined. All elements of a given array are# of the same data type with null value support.

typeDefs.name: NestedTableType
typeDefs.description: Represents an ordered set of data elements with a variable size.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Parses the returned `Xml` SQL value to a Ballerina value.

parameters.name: typeDesc
parameters.description: The `typedesc` of the type to which the result needs to be returned

return.description: The result in the `typeDesc` type, or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: get
functions.description: Parses the returned `IntervalYearToMonthOutParameter` SQL value to a Ballerina value.

parameters.name: typeDesc
parameters.description: The `typedesc` of the type to which the result needs to be returned

return.description: The result in the `typeDesc` type, or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: get
functions.description: Parses the returned `IntervalDayToSecondOutParameter` SQL value to a Ballerina value.

parameters.name: typeDesc
parameters.description: The `typedesc` of the type to which the result needs to be returned

return.description: The result in the `typeDesc` type, or an `sql:Error`

typeDefs.name: CustomResultIterator
typeDefs.description: The iterator for the stream returned from the `query` function to be used to override the default behaviour of `sql:ResultIterator`.

functions.name: init
functions.description: The iterator for the stream returned from the `query` function to be used to override the default behaviour of `sql:ResultIterator`.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the OracleDB Client. The client must be kept open throughout the application lifetime.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Hostname of the Oracle database server

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Name of a user of the Oracle database server

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password of the Oracle database server for the provided username

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: System identifier or the service name of the database

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number of the Oracle database server

parameters.name: connectionPool
parameters.description:
The `sql:ConnectionPool` object to be used within the client. If there is no
`connectionPool` provided, the global connection pool will be used

return.description: An `sql:Error` if the client creation fails

functions.name: query
functions.description:
Executes the query, which may return multiple results.
When processing the stream, make sure to consume all fetched data or close the stream.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `SELECT * from Album WHERE name=${albumName}` ``

parameters.name: rowType
parameters.description: The `typedesc` of the record to which the result needs to be returned

return.description: Stream of records in the `rowType` type

functions.name: queryRow
functions.description:
Executes the query, which is expected to return at most one row of the result.
If the query does not return any results, an `sql:NoRowsError` is returned.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `SELECT * from Album WHERE name=${albumName}` ``

parameters.name: returnType
parameters.description:
The `typedesc` of the record to which the result needs to be returned.
It can be a basic type if the query result contains only one column

return.description: Result in the `returnType` type or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: execute
functions.description: Executes the SQL query. Only the metadata of the execution is returned (not the results from the query).

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `DELETE FROM Album WHERE artist=${artistName}` ``

return.description: Metadata of the query execution as an `sql:ExecutionResult` or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: batchExecute
functions.description:
Executes the SQL query with multiple sets of parameters in a batch. Only the metadata of the execution is returned (not results from the query).
If one of the commands in the batch fails, the `sql:BatchExecuteError` will be returned immediately.

parameters.name: sqlQueries
parameters.description: The SQL query with multiple sets of parameters

return.description: Metadata of the query execution as an `sql:ExecutionResult[]` or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: call
functions.description:
Executes an SQL query, which calls a stored procedure. This may or may not
return results. Once the results are processed, the `close` method on `sql:ProcedureCallResult` must be called.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `CALL sp_GetAlbums();` ``

parameters.name: rowTypes
parameters.description: `typedesc` array of the records to which the results need to be returned

return.description: Summary of the execution and results are returned in an `sql:ProcedureCallResult`, or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the JDBC client and shuts down the connection pool. The client must be closed only at the end of the
application lifetime (or closed for graceful stops in a service).
